text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — service=redwood-inference-prod region=us-east-1a. Symptoms: large tail latencies on text-generation, spike in 502/5xx, automated fallback to us-east-1b engaged. Paging SRE oncall.

sre-oncall: ack — I'm on it. Starting high-level triage. @net-eng can you check host egress metrics, NIC tx queue, and resolver error rates?

net-eng: quick summary from host plane: sustained tx_queue_util > 90% across ephemeral hosts in us-east-1a, TCP retransmits up, some RSTs showing. Resolver timeouts climbed ~3x. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/egress/us-east-1a (short link). Looks like egress congestion at host/network layer.

eng-runtime: seeing kvcache regen storms and many cold cache misses — long model K/V pulls are amplifying per-token latency. Also multiple grpc stream stalls reported by runtime logs. Probable amplification: egress queuing -> GRPC stalls -> kvcache miss -> longer inference tails. Recommend draining traffic from the AZ while we stabilize.

sre-oncall: running drain on ephemeral inference pool now:```bash
kubectl -n inference drain inference-pool-us-east-1a-ephemeral --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```Initializing drain, cordon applied. Will follow with LB weight change.

cloudops: initiating traffic reweighting to us-east-1b. Command executed: `routeshift apply --service redwood-inference-prod --from us-east-1a --to us-east-1b --weight 100 --force` — propagated to global LB, starting now. Expect convergence ~120s. Also applying egress QDisc fallback on hosts to relieve tx queue pressure.

devex: customer impact snapshot: ~3.8% of inference calls returned transient 5xx in last 10m, user-facing latency p95 jumped from 220ms -> 1.8s during spike window. No persisted data loss; retry logic handled most retries.

platform-pm: any dedicated customers affected (reserved capacity)? Potential SLA implications?

sre-oncall: dedicated pools pinned to us-east-1a did see increased latencies; we enabled cross-az fallback for pinned workloads (taking a few minutes to shift). Notifying account teams for customers with strict AZ pinning. Will capture SLA exposure in post-incident.

oncall2: taking over oncall for longer-term remediation and RCA. @sre-oncall handing off; will coordinate follow-ups and postmortem. I'll continue monitoring until pods fully redistributed.

comms: draft incident note added to https://docs.google.com/... — short status update ready, tagging cust-signal and sales ops for review. Suggested message: "We experienced elevated inference errors and latency from us-east-1a due to an AZ-level egress congestion issue; traffic has been shifted and mitigation is underway."

incidents-bot: auto-update — routing now ~95% to us-east-1b, tail latency trending down. Continued monitoring advised for 15m.

sre-oncall: leaving notes: collected tcpdump on two hosts, pulled kernel tx_sched backlog metrics, and captured kvcache miss histograms. Will post artifacts to the incident runbook. Handing complete operational control to @oncall2. Staying available for context. :handshake:
